summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — STMPA.PA +15%, IFX.DE +10%, PRX.AS +9%, ANTO.L +6%, ASML.AS +5%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (CAP.PA -8%, AAF.L -5%, DSY.PA -4%, SGE.L -4%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: STMPA.PA (+15.14%) — ST raised 2026 data-centre revenue target to ~$1B (from 'nicely above $500M') and 2027 to ~$2B, citing surging AI infrastructure demand — announced June 2 after close. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — STMPA.PA is a large-cap Paris-listed semiconductor not currently in scope. Even if added, the guidance-raise PR dropped after the prior close; the gap was fully priced in at open, leaving no clean intraday entry signal.

top_movers.catalyst: ST raised 2026 data-centre revenue target to ~$1B (from 'nicely above $500M') and 2027 to ~$2B, citing surging AI infrastructure demand — announced June 2 after close.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — STMPA.PA is a large-cap Paris-listed semiconductor not currently in scope. Even if added, the guidance-raise PR dropped after the prior close; the gap was fully priced in at open, leaving no clean intraday entry signal.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a guidance-raise event scanner for Euronext large-caps: when a company PR lifts a key revenue metric ≥40%, whitelist the ticker for a momentum entry within 30 min of open if same-session volume ≥2× its 30-day average.

top_movers.catalyst: Infineon announced its OPTIGA TPM SLB 9672 certified for NVIDIA Jetson Thor, providing quantum-resilient hardware root-of-trust for Physical AI robotics — high-profile NVIDIA co-branding triggered the re-rating.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe; IFX.DE is a XETRA large-cap semiconductor. Move was news-driven (NVIDIA co-brand press release at open) — momentum signals would only confirm after most of the gap had already printed.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a news-reactive watchlist covering major XETRA/Euronext semis (IFX.DE, STM, ASML) that triggers an entry when a verified NVIDIA/AI-partner press release precedes a ≥5% open gap, with a 30-minute entry window post-open.

top_movers.catalyst: EU Commission granted Prosus a waiver extending its Delivery Hero stake reduction deadline past August, letting it potentially block or negotiate Uber's ~25% takeover bid for Delivery Hero.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. PRX is a large-cap Euronext Amsterdam holding co; +9.4% gap triggered by an intraday EU regulatory waiver with no pre-market signal — impossible to pre-position for news-reactive or momentum strategies.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap Euronext names (mkt-cap > €10B) to the news-reactive strategy's universe and implement an EU regulatory announcement scanner that triggers intraday entries within 15 min of an EC press release matching held-position tickers.

top_movers.catalyst: Trump's Jun 1 Section 232 proclamation adjusted copper tariff structure (eff. Jun 8); Chile's cathode copper largely exempt, amplifying ANTO.L's pure-play copper beta as LME copper held 2-week highs.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. ANTO.L is a pure-play Chilean copper miner (~98% copper revenue); its price action tracks LME copper multiples ahead of diversified peers, making it orthogonal to equity-technical momentum filters.
top_movers.suggestion: Add ANTO.L to a commodity-linked tier: include it when LME copper 20-day return exceeds +8%, flag for momentum entry with the equity-volume pre-filter waived on Section 232 / policy-event days.

top_movers.catalyst: ASML crossed Europe's all-time market-cap record (~$674B) on AI-infrastructure EUV demand; Q1 2026 beat consensus and FY guidance was raised, sustaining a 60% YTD advance.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — ASML is a mega-cap Euronext name (~€670B mkt cap, ~€1,460/share) whose sustained 60% YTD rally and high absolute price likely place it outside the bot's cap-tier definitions and per-share position-sizing constraints.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a large-cap EU semiconductor equipment basket (ASML, BESI, ASMI) to the momentum strategy's universe with a hard ≤1% NAV position cap, triggered only when the name is within 5% of its 52-week high on >1.2× average volume.

top_movers.catalyst: Copper prices held near record LME highs (~$13,800/t) on supply fears from Chile's weakest April output in 23 years; Glencore's Q1 copper production +19% YoY and marketing EBIT set to beat guidance top-end (>$3.5B) amplified the re-rating.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — GLEN.L is a FTSE 100 mega-cap diversified miner (~£40B+ market cap) whose +4.57% move was a diffuse commodity-beta event, not a discrete newsflow trigger; no single pre-market catalyst makes it actionable for news-reactive or gap-up filters.
top_movers.suggestion: Introduce a commodity-beta satellite universe: flag FTSE 100 miners (SIC 1000-1499) for entry when LME copper spot rises ≥+1.5% on the prior session close, gated by average daily volume ≥10M shares to avoid illiquid names.

top_movers.catalyst: Jefferies cut price target EUR 145→115 and Berenberg cut EUR 143→117 (both Hold), representing ~20% target reductions, landing the day after the EUR 3.40 ex-dividend date (June 2).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — CAP.PA is a large-cap French IT-services name (~€30B market cap). Analyst-coordinated repricing events have no pre-market technical footprint; without the name already in a universe, no filter could have triggered.
top_movers.suggestion: Extend a news-reactive strategy's universe to include CAC 40 IT-services names; add an 'analyst consensus target cut ≥15% same-day' signal to gate entries, which would have flagged CAP.PA at open without requiring prior position.

top_movers.catalyst: No fresh company catalyst on 2026-06-03; continuation of sector de-rating — enterprise software rotation on AI disruption fears, stock testing Citi's EUR 19 floor following May 22 Zacks Strong-Sell and a fresh broker Hold downgrade citing uncertain growth re-acceleration.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. DSY.PA is a CAC 40 large-cap industrial software name (Euronext Paris); the bot's strategies likely cover different sector profiles. Even if screened, the persistent 22%+ YTD downtrend and extreme Feb gap-down (-21%) would flag it as a broken-trend name excluded by momentum filte
top_movers.suggestion: Add a 'sector-rotation short proxy' rule: when ≥3 analyst downgrades hit a CAC 40 software name within 90 days, allow a mean-reversion short entry in a news-reactive strategy, gated on 20-day realised vol < 40% to avoid post-crash gap names.

top_movers.catalyst: Sector-wide software pullback 2026-06-03: algorithmic profit-taking reversed prior-day AI-optimism rally sparked by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang; global software ETF -2.8%, SGE.L retraced its prior-session +6.7% bounce.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. SGE.L is a FTSE 100 UK accounting-SaaS name deep in the 2026 AI-disruption sell-off (-37% since Jan 2025); June 3's drop was a sector-bounce reversal with no stock-specific catalyst — unreachable by standard pre-trade filters.
top_movers.suggestion: If short capability exists, add FTSE 100 software names to a sector-fade universe and trigger entries on constituents with 20-day return below -15% when the global software ETF reverses >1% intraday after a prior-day gain ≥4%.
